Plugin.Name: Thunderbolt Net
Plugin.Overview: Host-to-host networking over Thunderbolt 3/4/5 and USB4 / USB4 v2 wherever Linux exposes thunderbolt_net. Multi-peer tbn tabs, trained rates/lanes (honest — sticker 40/80G-class is not guaranteed TCP), services on TB IPs, known peers; optional OpenFabric (FRR packages via separate UnraidFRR). Configure under Settings → Network Settings → Thunderbolt / tbnN.
